brief: Two-day workshop in Leipzig for 30 people, 1 night, arriving 2027-02-16. Keep it as cheap as possible, budget EUR 10,000.

input.summary: Two policy-compliant Leipzig venues are open on 2027-02-16 and both come in under the EUR 10,000 budget. The cheapest in town, Kesselhalle Plagwitz (EUR 7,770), is on the blocked vendor list, so I left it out. Druckerei Forum is the cheapest of the remaining options.

offers.tradeOff: Cheapest compliant option and has 4 workshop rooms, but it is EUR 420 more than the cheapest-in-town venue would have been and leaves only about EUR 760 of budget headroom.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

offers.tradeOff: Preferred vendor with a calm setting and garden, but EUR 420 more than Druckerei Forum and close to the budget cap.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

rfp.subject: Request for proposal: 2-day workshop, 16-17 Feb 2027, 30 guests
rfp.body:
Hello,

We are planning a two-day workshop and would like a proposal.

Arrival: 2027-02-16, departure 2027-02-17 (1 night)
Guests: 30
Room nights: 30 single-occupancy rooms for 1 night
Meeting space: one main workshop room for both days, with lunch and coffee for 30 guests on each day. No breakout rooms needed.
Dietary needs: none reported yet
Accessibility: no wheelchair users
Budget: all-in cost for the stay under EUR 10,000 (including group travel from Berlin). Please quote your best price.

Please reply by 2026-10-25 with availability, a full price breakdown and your terms.

Thank you.
